description: Roth IRA Calculator with a chart, the same math as the web page. How much could your Roth IRA grow? A Roth IRA is a retirement account you open yourself. You pay tax on the money first, so growth can come out tax-free later. It grows yearly Roth IRA deposits at the rate you pick, up to the IRS limit. It also checks the 2026 income limit. It does not say what your money will earn. The growth rate is one you pick. People ask for it as "roth ira calculator", "roth ira growth calculator" or "how much will my roth ira be worth".

add.description: Money you put in each year. US dollars. The most for 2026 is $7,500, or $8,600 at 50 or older. Default: 5000.

bal.description: Money in your Roth IRA now. US dollars. Default: 0.

grow.description: Grow like. Your own rate, or a past average used for the future. Default: own.

income.description: Your income for the year. US dollars. Leave blank to skip. The IRS uses modified AGI, your income after some set deductions. Empty if left out.

later.description: Your tax rate when you retire. A percent: 5 means 5%. Fill both to compare with a traditional IRA. Empty if left out.

now.description: Your tax rate now. A percent: 5 means 5%. Empty if left out.

rate.description: Growth each year. A percent: 5 means 5%. A guess, not a promise. Default: 6.

retire.description: Age you want to retire. In years. Default: 65.

status.description: Check if your income lets you put in. Head of household counts as single. Married, filing apart, and lived apart all year? Pick single. Default: single.
